policy.window: current Europe/Madrid calendar day; outcome becomes observable today
policy.auctions: won/lost bids and notable no-bid opportunities use contemporaneous VM and observed rival bids
policy.holds: active offers can appear provisional and never affect the global score
policy.lineup: evaluated the day the tracker observes the gameweek as Finalizada
policy.history: older market actions stay outside today's score
policy.fairness: uncertain evidence is omitted instead of invented

v90_finalizer.policy: Only high-evidence omissions are surfaced; pre-auction context is preferred over post-auction current state.

v92_evaluator_filter.policy: Active offers are not graded. A no-sale only appears after resolution when hindsight says it was doubtful or bad; obvious good holds stay silent.
